  Cargo.toml                           # [workspace] members = ["crates/*"]
  rust-toolchain.toml                  # pinned stable
  crates/
    station-sdk/                        # from packages/sdk — plugin SDK types/traits
      src/{lib.rs, common.rs, storage.rs, config.rs, history.rs, ipc.rs,
           resources.rs, session.rs, search.rs, activity.rs, tabs.rs, react.rs}
    manifest-registry/                  # from packages/app/manifests + abstract-application helpers
      src/{lib.rs, model.rs, search.rs, private.rs, config_rules.rs}
      definitions/                      # embedded via include_dir (JSON manifests, kept verbatim)
    activity/                           # from packages/app/src/activity
      src/{lib.rs, store.rs, query.rs}
      migrations/                       # sqlx SQLite migrations
    appstore-schema/                    # from packages/appstore graphql data layer
      schema/api.graphqls               # verbatim copy of api-schema.graphqls
      src/{lib.rs, types.rs, state.rs}
    station-shell/                      # Tauri app (bin) — last slices land here
      src/{main.rs, about.rs, protocols.rs, commands/appstore.rs}
      tauri.conf.json
      frontend/                         # retained React UI (appstore + about), vite-built
        (ported from packages/appstore/src + about-window content)

open_questions: Shell strategy is the plan's biggest fork: Tauri v2 (assumed by slices 11-16) vs wry-direct vs keep-Electron-shell-with-Rust-core (NAPI). Deciding anything but Tauri reshapes slices 12-16.

tabs/BrowserView epic is out of inventoried scope: ~49 of 564 files import electron, tabs use BrowserView/webContents everywhere (the 'real moat'). station-sdk tabs trait (s04) declares the surface, but the webview host impl needs its own follow-up plan.

GraphQL fate: client Apollo cache is pure UI state with NO transport (Client.ts has no HttpLink; remote queries dead, HOCs on mocks/bxApi). Plan collapses it into typed Rust/TS state (s10/s14) — confirm no requirement to keep a GraphQL API (async-graphql/cynic parity would change s10/s11).

Remote Station API (api.getstation.com/graphql): dead in practice. Drop entirely (plan assumes yes) or wire a real client? Also decides whether UPDATE_APPLICATION_FROM_RECIPE/DELETE_APPLICATION ever get a backend.

Station plugin runtime host side (packages/app/src/sdk providers, manifests/runtime plugins: slack/gdrive/notion/slite; 66 files import @getstation/sdk) — ported into station-shell after s04, but not sliced here; needs its own inventory pass.

Unverified crate picks pending per-slice ctx7 re-runs under Node 24 (machine has Node 22, npm EBADDEVENGINES; pnpm dlx works): fuzzy-search crate (fuse.js equivalent — fuse-rust vs tantivy vs hand-rolled), handlebars templating crate, tokio-stream watch/broadcast choices for sdk consumers. Only sqlx SQLite was verified this pass.
Canary channel (scripts/canary.js, getstation/station-canary): delete, port to git2/octocrab, or adopt cargo-dist/tauri-action channel semantics? Not sliced until decided.
Not a git repo (no .git) — slice-per-PR discipline requires initializing git / deciding fork relationship to getstation/desktop-app before slice 1 merges anywhere.
macOS codesigning/notarization currently disabled upstream (afterSign commented out) — restore under Tauri's native notarization in s15 or keep disabled?
